title: Rebrand Tauri app icon to 'd' (same red-background Dash icon)
description: The favicon/browser icon was updated to a red background with bold 'd' in white (task 0719). The Tauri desktop app icon at apps/desktop/src-tauri/icons/ still shows the old Flash 'F' icon. Replace ALL Tauri icon variants (32x32.png, 128x128.png, 128x128@2x.png, icon.icns, icon.ico, icon.png) with the new Dash 'd' branding: red (#cc0000) background, bold white 'd'. Use a proper raster/vector approach — generate each PNG size programmatically (canvas/sharp/node-canvas or similar), then use Tauri's icon generation if available, or just provide the PNG files. The icon.icns and icon.ico should ideally be regenerated too. Acceptance: running the Tauri desktop app shows the red-d icon in the dock/taskbar.
